records.text: Frank Turek said no CPR was performed during most of the ride to the hospital, but he tried CPR for about 20 or 30 seconds at the very end.
records.speaker: Frank Turek

appearances.snippet: Brian (Brian Harpole) is correct that most of the ride, we weren't doing any CPR. We couldn't do CPR. We're trying to stop the bleeding. ... So I tried that for like 20 or 30 seconds at the very end of the ride when we're pulling into the hospital parking lot and we're yanking and banking our way there.

verification.notes: The source-scoped transcript directly records Frank Turek saying most of the ride involved no CPR and that he attempted it during the final 20-30 seconds. Earlier public accounts also record Turek saying he called for CPR. This verifies what Turek said in the later clarification, not whether the attempted CPR occurred as described.
